context: Tests that an approved identity and a clean mechanical sweep do not substitute for representative prose. The response must keep voice calibration unresolved while reporting every review state independently.

checklist.name: Assignment mode named
checklist.description: The report identifies the assignment mode as analytical opinion or an equivalently specific mode.

checklist.name: Evidence rejected
checklist.description: The report says the links were not fetched, the summaries and isolated quotation are not usable multi-sentence prose, and the quotation has unknown authorship.

checklist.name: Voice remains unresolved
checklist.description: Voice calibration is explicitly unresolved; the report does not call it calibrated, passed, preserved, or matched.

checklist.name: No device-list imitation
checklist.description: The report does not claim that adding punchlines, direct address, or asides would establish Rowan's voice.

checklist.name: Independent review states
checklist.description: Mechanical sweep, manual anti-pattern review, voice calibration, and paragraph continuity are each reported as separate states; a zero-hit sweep is not used as proof of voice.

checklist.name: Evidence request is actionable
checklist.description: The report requests two or three contiguous multi-sentence analytical-opinion passages with stable locators and authorship classified as solely authored, collaborative, or heavily edited.

checklist.name: No fabricated evidence
checklist.description: The response does not invent passage text, provenance, fetched content, or authorship.
